summary: Initial public development package, desktop app, downloadable models, exports and privacy notices.
Fix test temporary directories for fresh CI checkouts.
Experimental overlap-only source separation, manual assignments and confirmed speaker-lane clips.
Place Transcript/Timeline beside the spectrogram in the desktop workspace.
Allow overlapping speaker-lane playback, with original-mix fallback.
Click transcript text to seek recording and spectrogram; keep double-click editing.
Grouped speaker answers, remembered Auto-scroll and optional Gemma punctuation suggestions.
Reviewed grammar/completion suggestions, highlighted changes, local Gemma reuse and export provenance.
Clean desktop packaging to prevent stale bundled Python modules.
Refresh previews; add shared version, changelog and automatic tags/releases; disable PR submissions while retaining public downloads and restrict CI to main/manual runs.
Fix release publishing with the limited Actions token: tag the current checked commit and retain older versions as exact source links.
Reduce post-transcription lag with conditional transcript refresh, cached storage inventory and speaker playback, and indexed sentence grouping.
Load voice-sample spectrograms on demand and index activity lanes so overlap markers appear only for their participating speakers, avoiding oversized review rendering.
Show a native recovery panel and reload action when the embedded display crashes or fails to load; log renderer exit diagnostics without transcript content.
Reduce scrolling work with off-screen render containment and indexed playback highlighting; pause auto-follow during manual scrolling.
Recognize direct opening names without I am or ako si, including greetings, surname particles, initials and adjacent introduction fragments; preserve review and evidence checks.
Add bounded global voice classification, a reviewed local voice-profile library, moderate cleanup defaults and failure-safe result preservation.
Make transcript text and timestamp clicks pause and seek without autoplay, while retaining explicit playback controls.
Edit speaker names, answer assignments and transcript content together from transcript-panel controls, preserving original annotations and timings.
Expand identified overlap into simultaneous speaker transcript rows with separate editable words and matching export timestamps.
